import { shadows } from '@advui/theme'

// Shared by Dialog and AlertDialog so both surfaces stay identical. Each wraps
// its own Tamagui primitive (they use separate contexts), so only styles are shared.

export const overlayStyle = {
  backgroundColor: 'overlay',
  opacity: { default: 1, enter: 0, exit: 0 },
} as const

export const contentStyle = {
  backgroundColor: 'popover',
  borderColor: 'border',
  borderWidth: 1,
  borderRadius: 'dialog',
  padding: '6',
  gap: '4',
  width: '92%',
  maxWidth: '128',
  maxHeight: '90%',
  ...shadows.lg,
  opacity: { default: 1, enter: 0, exit: 0 },
  scale: { default: 1, enter: 0.96, exit: 0.98 },
  y: { default: 0, enter: 8, exit: 4 },
} as const

export const contentSizes = {
  sm: { maxWidth: '96' },
  md: { maxWidth: '128' },
  lg: { maxWidth: '168' },
  xl: { maxWidth: '224' },
} as const

export const headerStyle = { gap: '1-5' } as const

export const footerStyle = {
  flexDirection: 'column-reverse sm:row',
  justifyContent: 'sm:flex-end',
  gap: '2',
} as const

export const titleStyle = {
  fontFamily: 'heading',
  fontSize: '5',
  lineHeight: '5',
  fontWeight: '600',
  color: 'foreground',
  margin: 0,
} as const

export const descriptionStyle = {
  fontFamily: 'body',
  fontSize: '2',
  lineHeight: '2',
  color: 'mutedForeground',
  margin: 0,
} as const
export { Dialog, type DialogContentProps, type DialogProps } from './Dialog'

examples.name: basic
examples.title: Edit form
examples.code:
import { Button, Dialog, Input, Label, VStack } from '@advui/core'

export default function DialogBasic() {
  return (
    <Dialog>
      <Dialog.Trigger asChild>
        <Button variant="outline">Edit profile</Button>
      </Dialog.Trigger>
      <Dialog.Content>
        <Dialog.Header>
          <Dialog.Title>Edit profile</Dialog.Title>
          <Dialog.Description>Make changes to your profile here.</Dialog.Description>
        </Dialog.Header>
        <VStack gap="3">
          <VStack gap="2">
            <Label htmlFor="dlg-name">Name</Label>
            <Input id="dlg-name" defaultValue="Ada Lovelace" />
          </VStack>
          <VStack gap="2">
            <Label htmlFor="dlg-username">Username</Label>
            <Input id="dlg-username" defaultValue="@ada" />
          </VStack>
        </VStack>
        <Dialog.Footer>
          <Dialog.Close asChild>
            <Button variant="outline">Cancel</Button>
          </Dialog.Close>
          <Button>Save changes</Button>
        </Dialog.Footer>
      </Dialog.Content>
    </Dialog>
  )
}

examples.name: confirm
examples.title: Controlled confirmation
examples.code:
import { Button, Dialog, toast } from '@advui/core'
import { useState } from 'react'

export default function DialogConfirm() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
      <Dialog.Trigger asChild>
        <Button variant="destructive">Delete project</Button>
      </Dialog.Trigger>
      <Dialog.Content size="sm" hideCloseButton>
        <Dialog.Header>
          <Dialog.Title>Delete this project?</Dialog.Title>
          <Dialog.Description>This permanently deletes “Atlas” and its data.</Dialog.Description>
        </Dialog.Header>
        <Dialog.Footer>
          <Dialog.Close asChild>
            <Button variant="outline">Keep project</Button>
          </Dialog.Close>
          <Button
            variant="destructive"
            onPress={() => {
              setOpen(false)
              toast.success('Project deleted')
            }}
          >
            Delete
          </Button>
        </Dialog.Footer>
      </Dialog.Content>
    </Dialog>
  )
}
